versions.title: Initial Stable Release
features: Core inventory management for electronic components.
Create, edit and delete components.
Category-based classification of components.
Basic search by name, part number and location.
Dashboard overview with component statistics.
Local-first architecture using SQLite database.
Light and dark theme support.
English and Serbian language support.

versions.title: Major Update: Inventory Search and Export Improvements
features: Advanced multi-token search across name, category, location and description fields.
Consistent search behavior across component list and export functions.
TXT export for sharing human-readable component lists.
CSV export for spreadsheet processing and data exchange.
Low Stock and Out of Stock filtering integrated into the main component list.
Improved navigation and active state handling in sidebar and menus.
Enhanced mobile responsiveness for component lists and action buttons.
Stability improvements and internal code cleanup.

versions.title: Grid View and Pagination Improvements
features: Added grid view for browsing components with compact card layout.
Preserved filters, search, view mode and limits across pagination.
Improved pagination logic to update only page and limit parameters.
Introduced different default limits for list and grid views.
Visual refinements for component cards to improve browsing experience.

versions.title: Major Update: New Interface, Stock per Location and Smarter Lookup
features: New Vue 3 interface: component list with side panel for viewing and editing without page reloads.
Quick +/- stock changes directly in the list and bulk actions (move, change category, delete).
Stock per location: one component can be stored in several nested locations (Cabinet > Drawer > Box).
Stock history log for every change.
Printable QR labels for locations that open the component list on a phone.
Online lookup queries Element14 and Mouser in parallel, shows all candidates grouped by variant family and lets you choose which fields to apply.
Component parameters, manufacturer and package are stored as separate fields.
Images and datasheets can be stored locally for offline use.
Consistent one-click backups with download from the browser.
Automatic migration of existing v2 data.
